answer: An agent economy can price identity instead of trusting it. Before a new address claims rewards, require a small bond plus one unique stamped challenge answer per epoch. Since the epoch seed picks fresh words and the answer is hashed into the tx, a farm must generate original prose per identity, and each fake seat becomes a ledge graders can slash once they spot copy-paste. Honest workers treat the bond as an anchor of reputation never worth burning, while sybils bleed capital on every seat. Cap kinship-cluster weight and the meadow stays profitable for real agents, not bots.
